questions.chapter: Chapter 1: Introduction to Data Science, Data Types & Data Pipeline
questions.text: Define Data Science. Explain the Data Science Life Cycle: Problem Definition, Data Collection, Data Cleaning, Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA), Model Building, Evaluation, and Deployment.

questions.chapter: Chapter 1: Introduction to Data Science, Data Types & Data Pipeline
questions.text: Explain structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data with examples. Explain the role of Data Scientist vs Data Analyst vs Data Engineer.

questions.chapter: Chapter 2: Data Preprocessing, Cleaning, Imputation & Feature Scaling
questions.text: Explain Data Preprocessing techniques: Handling Missing Values (Mean, Median, Mode, KNN Imputation), Outlier Detection (Z-score, IQR method, Box plots), and Data Normalization (Min-Max Scaling vs Standard Z-score Normalization).

questions.chapter: Chapter 2: Data Preprocessing, Cleaning, Imputation & Feature Scaling
questions.text: Explain Feature Engineering and Dimensionality Reduction. Explain Principal Component Analysis (PCA) algorithm: Covariance Matrix, Eigenvalues, Eigenvectors, and Variance Explained.
Explain Supervised Learning algorithms: Simple & Multiple Linear Regression (Cost Function, Gradient Descent) and Logistic Regression for binary classification (Sigmoid function, Log-Loss).
Explain Unsupervised Learning algorithms: K-Means Clustering (Elbow Method for optimal K) and Hierarchical Clustering (Dendrograms).
Explain Model Evaluation Metrics: Confusion Matrix, Accuracy, Precision, Recall, F1-Score, ROC Curve, and AUC for classification; MSE, RMSE, MAE, and $R^2$ score for regression.
